title: Product mix
summary: A workshop makes chairs and tables from limited wood and labour. Find the mix that earns the most, and see why the best plan sits at a corner of what is possible.
origin: Written for this project: spec 2's product mix (benchmarks/product_mix), written by the review council; the idea of a two-product linear programme is the textbook prototype (Hillier and Lieberman), but no number or wording of theirs is used (docs/research/spec-4-template-sources.md).
